deep_dives.title: Euronaval 2026: France Orders 32-Cell Aster Missile Upgrade for FDI Frigates
deep_dives.what_happened: France officially ordered a 32-cell VLS upgrade for the French Navy's FDI frigates at Euronaval 2026, doubling their Aster missile air defense capacity. The post Euronaval 2026: France Orders 32-Cell Aster Missile Upgrade for FDI Frigates appeared first on Naval News .

deep_dives.title: European troops set to train in Poland for postwar Ukraine deployment
deep_dives.what_happened: Britain and France will lead 2,800 troops from 11 nations in a two-week exercise testing how to move, protect and supply a force to rebuild Ukraine’s military after the war ends.

deep_dives.title: US Army feeds culinary soldiers new job title
deep_dives.what_happened: Formerly known as culinary specialists, a soldier with the 92G occupation identifier will henceforth be known as a “tactical field feeding specialist.”

deep_dives.title: US, Colombian troops kick off exercise amid the Pentagon’s Western Hemisphere pivot
deep_dives.what_happened: Hundreds of American and Colombian troops kicked off a sprawling military exercise in Colombia this week as the U.S. military sharpens its focus on the Western Hemisphere.
